items.title: Descent of the braiding through a transparent de-equivariantization
items.difficulty_reason: Given the author’s module tensor product over the transparent regular function algebra, the new proof shows that the ordinary braiding matches both defining balanced relations. One square is naturality; the other requires the full author hexagon and transparency diagram (8.102). The comparison gives the isomorphism of difference cokernels and the descended braiding compatible with the free module functor. The actual parallel-pair proof is independent of recovering the category by inverse equivariantization.

proof_spans.source_role: Complete author proof attributed to Pareigis, both squares of (8.101), full (8.102), and final descended difference-cokernel braiding. Stop before Exercise 8.23.9.

Actual structural portion of 8.23.3 proof: right modules over Fun(G,k), left action, relative tensor product, free module tensor functor (8.99), and separately Definition 8.23.4. The inverse comparison after 2337 is excluded.
Original lead-in to 8.23.8, transparent Tannakian context only.

source_roles.source_scope: Original braided fusion D, finite group G and fully faithful braided tensor functor Rep(G)→D′. D_G is the original right-module de-equivariantization construction over A=Fun(G,k), with the complete statement including (8.100) and D→D_G. No added nondegeneracy or assumptions on general arbitrary algebras.
source_roles.source_label_caveats: Original (8.101) top parallel map prints c_{N,A} on A⊗N; the adjacent path and (8.102) explicitly show c_{A,N}, which equals c_{N,A}^{−1} under the stated transparency. The official correction is for the separate left arrow. The statement calls D→D_G forgetful, while (8.99) explicitly gives it as the free-module tensor functor. Preserve all original labels and compare their source endpoints, without replacing the author proof.
source_roles.official_corrections_only: Separate official author errata p6 [2217,2311), exact left-arrow entry. No changed labels inserted into original PDF.
